description: Use this when the user shares a Meta Ad Library link (facebook.com/ads/library) and wants the ad's copy, media and video transcript to study or remix. Holds up to 18 credits and charges the real cost. May return a `job_id` for xcut_get_job. Do not use for organic Facebook posts (use xcut_import_post).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

name: xcut_import_meta_ad
title: Import a Meta ad
